examples.en: I had a lot of things in my heart that I wanted to say.

examples.ko: 가슴속 울분을 글로 풀어내자 마음이 한결 가벼워졌어요.
examples.en: Once I let out the anger in my heart through writing, my mind felt much lighter.

examples.ko: 그 말을 가슴속 깊이 새겨 두었어요.
examples.en: I engraved those words deep in my heart.
It feels refreshing, as if my chest were wide open.

examples.ko: 가슴속에만 담아 두지 말고 이야기해 보세요.
examples.en: Don't keep it only inside your heart. Try talking about it.

examples.ko: 아버지의 마지막 말씀이 아직도 가슴속에 남아 있어요.
examples.en: My father's last words still remain in my heart.

explain: '마음속'과 비슷하지만 '가슴속'은 울분이나 그리움처럼 가슴이 답답하거나 벅찬 감정에 잘 어울려요. 생각이나 기억은 '머릿속'이라고 해요. 보통 '가슴속에', '가슴속 깊이'처럼 써요.

phrases.en: I kept those words deep in my heart.
phrases.nuance_ko: 감정이나 말을 아주 깊이 품고 있을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when you hold a feeling or words very deeply inside.

phrases.example: 그날의 일이 아직도 가슴속에 남아 있어요.
phrases.en: What happened that day still stays in my heart.
phrases.nuance_ko: 잊히지 않는 감정이나 일이 오래 마음에 있을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when a feeling or event stays with you and isn't forgotten.

phrases.en: I have a lot of worries on my mind.
phrases.nuance_ko: '가슴속'과 비슷하지만 '마음속'은 감정뿐 아니라 생각에도 두루 쓸 수 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Similar to 가슴속, but 마음속 is broader and can be used for thoughts as well as feelings.

explain_en: It is similar to '마음속', but '가슴속' fits feelings that make the chest tight or full, like anger or longing. Thoughts and memories go in '머릿속'. It is usually used as '가슴속에' or '가슴속 깊이'.

examples.en: I resolved to exercise steadily this year.

examples.ko: 친구는 매일 책을 읽기로 결심해서 도서관 카드를 만들었어요.
examples.en: My friend resolved to read every day, so she made a library card.

examples.ko: 그는 한국에서 살기로 결심한 뒤에 한국어를 배웠어요.
examples.en: After he decided to live in Korea, he learned Korean.
I made up my mind to study abroad and sent my documents to the school.
Even if you resolve to, keeping it isn't easy.
Since it was a hard decision for you, I'll cheer you on too.

explain: '-기로 결심하다'처럼 앞으로 할 일을 굳게 정할 때 자주 써요. 선택지 중에서 하나를 고를 때는 '결정하다'를 쓰고, 가벼운 마음은 '마음먹다'가 더 입말이에요. '결심이 서다'처럼 명사로도 나와요.

phrases.en: I decided to learn English next year.
phrases.nuance_ko: 표제어를 해요체 과거로 말한 형태로, 이미 마음을 정했다고 알릴 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The polite past form, used to say you have already made up your mind.

phrases.en: I made up my mind to go to bed early from today.
phrases.nuance_ko: '결심하다'와 뜻이 비슷하지만 가벼운 결정이고 입말에서 더 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Similar to '결심하다' but lighter and more common in speech.

phrases.en: I finally made up my mind to move.
phrases.nuance_ko: 명사 '결심'을 써서 마음이 굳게 정해졌다는 뜻을 나타내요.
phrases.nuance_en: Uses the noun '결심' to say that one's resolve has firmly formed.

explain_en: It is often used as '-기로 결심하다' when firmly settling on what you will do. Picking one of several options is '결정하다', and a lighter resolve is more casually '마음먹다'. It also appears as a noun in '결심이 서다'.
